scope: Listed lifecycle plus direct production callers/callees; broader inventory locates calls but does not expand subject.
alias_followup: Trace imports/aliases and call sites of hits using literal-name rg; log every adaptive query and reason. Empty substring matches are not a proof of absence.
libraries: Count stochastic sources in libraries actually called on an in-scope production path. Inspect locally installed or vendored source read-only, record version and hashes. No dependency installation or execution. Missing source or unresolved call path is UNKNOWN, not determinism. Inspect stdlib RNG where needed; it does not establish ideal IID.
production_vs_external: Classify repeat decision separately: internal code; external human; external AI; hybrid/unknown. Only internally triggered reachable repeat is a candidate; external or unresolved controls do not pass.
excluded: Tests/fixtures, generated examples, earlier random harness, identity/token generation without stochastic repair, unrelated subsystems, external restart decisions. Retain hit records and reason for exclusions.
candidate_order: At most three reachable stochastic lifecycle candidates, sorted by random-draw source path and line, including reached library paths; one mechanism is one candidate, not each call-site occurrence.
timing: Start before source identity validation/inspection; UTC and monotonic clock; hard source gate deadline start+1800s, final report separately recorded. No experiment or theorem run.
stop: NO_MATCH or UNKNOWN ends study; no new subject/revision/external random repair fallback.
